title: Prescription Continuity for Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy standing note — Autoship Pharmacy and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy**

A pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship follows its linked prescription.

- **Going on hold.** It goes on prescription hold when a shipment comes due and the prescription cannot be filled; the pharmacy then requests a renewal from the prescribing veterinarian.
- **Release.** The hold is released as soon as the linked prescription is in status active with at least one fill remaining, and the held shipment is processed on the release date.
- **Automatic cancellation.** A subscription still on prescription hold the program's prescription-hold limit in calendar days after the hold began is cancelled automatically.
- **Changing the linked prescription.** Linking a different prescription to an existing pharmacy subscription is allowed only when it is for the same medication, strength and pet; otherwise a new subscription is needed.
- **Dates and skips.** A prescription hold never moves the scheduled ship date backward and never counts as a skip.

## Linking another prescription: combinations

| Same medication | Same strength | Same pet | Link to the existing subscription |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Allowed |
| Yes | Yes | No | Not allowed: a new subscription is needed |
| Yes | No | Yes | Not allowed: a new subscription is needed |
| No | any | any | Not allowed: a new subscription is needed |

## Hold timeline (hypothetical, hold limit 30 days)

Hold begins on day 0. The prescription becomes active with a fill remaining on day 12: the hold is released and the held shipment is processed on day 12. Had the prescription still been unfillable on day 30, the subscription would have been cancelled automatically on that day.
